meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,当 Claude 做代码审查时,会把意见写成一行一条:标明行号、指出问题和具体修法,删掉客套话。输出可直接粘贴到 PR 评论区。
howto.when: 当你说 /caveman-review、'review this PR' 等指令来审查代码时,进入压缩审查模式;说 'stop caveman-review' 会退出,恢复普通审查方式。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审查这次提交的改动。
say.note: 按“行号:问题。修复。”逐条输出。

say.text: 请 review 这个 PR 的 diff,每条意见带上具体行号。
say.note: 将以“文件:L<行>”的形式逐条反馈。

say.text: 停止 caveman-review,改用详细模式来写审查意见。
say.note: 恢复成带解释的长评论。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude writes code reviews as one-line findings: each line has exact line number, the problem, and a concrete fix. Fluff is removed. Output can be pasted straight into a PR thread.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for code review with /caveman-review, 'review this PR', etc. Saying 'stop caveman-review' restores the normal verbose review style.

say_en.text: Use caveman-review for the latest commit's changes.
say_en.note: Outputs one line per finding: line, issue, fix.

say_en.text: Review this PR diff and include exact line numbers.
Stop caveman-review and switch back to detailed writing.
